pageInfo.title: About Me
pageInfo.description: Hi! I'm Hakancan Ozturk, an AI Engineer at Amazon with a background in machine learning and computational science. I specialize in building AI-powered developer platforms, agentic systems, and production ML pipelines.

background.title: Background
background.content: I am an AI Engineer at Amazon, building the next generation of AI-powered developer tools. My work spans Claude-powered agentic platforms for oncall automation, LLM-based visual defect detection, and high-performance Rust services — all running at Amazon scale. Previously, I was a Founding Engineer at Albus Technologies, where I built production RAG systems serving 100K+ customers, and a Computing Researcher at the Max Planck Institute, where I achieved 200x speedups in CFD simulations through novel HPC scheduling. I hold an MSc in Applied Computational Science & Engineering from Imperial College London (Distinction, highest in class) and a BSc in Mechanical Engineering from Koc University (GPA 3.99, ranked 1st).
background.quote: I build AI systems that make developers more productive and software more reliable.
